# Copied from SLEIGHT-Bench

`control_arena.md` is `prompts/control_arena.md` of
[github.com/safety-research/sleight-bench](https://github.com/safety-research/sleight-bench) at
commit `218c58315cc01ff0dc5a100e906c27d82d259521`, byte for byte. It is the monitor prompt that
benchmark's authors publish. It is copied here under the benchmark's MIT licence, which is in
`LICENSE` beside it, so that lane 19s can bind the exact prompt by digest. It is not part of the
benchmark's encrypted attack data and carries no canary string.
